title: Enrolment opens

beats.text: Enrolment opens for 24 Jan, 7 Feb, 21 Feb.

cta: drsigma.net | 7 days of everything · no card
caption:
Enrolment opens today, 11 January, for the 24 Jan, 7 Feb and 21 Feb EMREE sittings (NIHS calendar). The 24 Jan window closes on the 20th.

Not sure which one? The free calculator on drsigma.net tells you which sitting your hours can reach.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #EMREE2027

fact.claim: Sittings 4-6 (24 Jan, 7 Feb, 21 Feb 2027) enrol from 11 Jan; sitting 4 window closes 20 Jan
